summary: Flyimg is a self-hosted service that dynamically resizes and crops images on demand. It processes graphic assets using ImageMagick and outputs optimised formats like MozJPEG, WebP, or PNG, while relying on a built-in caching layer to serve repeat requests quickly.
goodFor: This tool is a practical fit if you need to run your own dedicated image transformation pipeline behind a web application rather than depending on a third-party SaaS provider.
watchOut: Image processing is CPU-intensive, meaning heavy traffic can spike your server resource usage and require careful cache configuration to avoid performance degradation.
deployNotes: Because the application runs via Docker, you will typically need to mount a persistent volume for the cache directory and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
